notes:
Discovery notes: mid-market product analytics company building a conversational product help center + insights assistant. Currently on OpenAI for both chat & embeddings; migrating to reduce per-token cost and gain routing controls. Key ask: hosted evaluation first (fast onboarding) then Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Technical specifics / customer voice: - Workload: 60k MAU, peak concurrency ~45, avg prompt length 120 tokens, embedding volume 200k vectors/month. Latency target: median <150ms for short-turn support queries; p95 <400ms. Throughput goal for Dedicated: sustain 200 qps with burst to 500 for product releases.

Compatibility concerns: - "We have ~120 prompt templates and rely on OpenAI-specific function call behavior; prompt parity and stop-token/regression detection is critical" - CTO. - SE notes: expected friction points: streaming chunk boundaries, temperature/decoding default differences, model-variant mapping, tokenizer/token-count mismatch.

POC plan: - 2-week hosted POC using Redwood hosted_api with a compatibility layer mapping OpenAI endpoints. - Run automated prompt-parity suite (provided by ParseWorks) against current vendor; track regressions with Redwood Optimize eval hooks. - Measure latency, token cost, and quality delta on 500 representative prompts. - If pass gates (quality delta <3% on core intents + latency targets), scope Dedicated sizing and VPC setup.

Commercial / pricing: - CFO focused on unit economics: target 30% reduction in per-token cost after Dedicated commit. - Evaluating 12-mo reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go. Pricing asks in deck (linked).

Security / compliance: - Needs SAML SSO, long-term audit log retention (1yr), KMS integration for key rotation, and EU data residency for subset of customers. Procurement asked for SOC2 Type II report and incident response SLA.

Customer sentiment: engaged but cautious — "We're open to switch if we can prove parity and not regress search/intent performance". AE notes: prioritize quick hosted POC and provide a regression dashboard + remediation plan.
summary: Stonebridge ParseWorks evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated migration. Priority: prompt parity with existing OpenAI-based stack, cost savings, predictable latency. POC scoped: 2-week hosted run + automated parity eval; next step Dedicated sizing if gates pass.
